meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理最近改动里的 AI 味代码,并保证回归测试仍然通过
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 AI 写了不少代码,你想删掉坏味道再合并
copy.tagline_en: Clean AI-flavored code out of recent changes while keeping tests green
copy.fit_line_en: For you if AI wrote much of your code and you want the smells gone before merging

howto.what: 先给改动文件补回归测试锁住行为，再按类别清理 AI 代码味道（冗余注释、过度防御、死代码等），最后跑质量门禁和审查，验证不通过就回退或直接修改。
howto.when: 当你要求清理、deslop 或移除最近改动里的 AI 生成痕迹时触发。默认范围是分支与 main 的 merge-base 差异，也可传入文件列表。

say.text: 帮我把当前分支相对 main 的改动去一下 AI slop
say.note: 会先写回归测试再逐类清理

say.text: 把这次改动里的死代码和冗余注释清掉
say.note: 需先有绿色的测试基线

howto.what_en: Locks behavior with regression tests first, then runs a categorized cleanup of AI-generated smells (obvious comments, over-defensive code, dead code, etc.), then verifies with quality gates and review; reverts or edits directly on failure.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes. Default scope is the branch diff vs merge-base main; you can also pass a file list.

say_en.text: Clean the AI slop out of my branch diff against main.
Run remove-ai-slops on src/foo.py and src/bar.py.
Remove dead code and obvious comments from these changes.
say_en.note: Needs a green test baseline first.
